info.description:
API documentation for building your own audio client on Music Server.
 This API consists of "Standard API" with User, Admin and Guest APIs that allow you to manage your music library and user accounts.  These APIs have a single input and response format and return JSON, except where serving image/audio files and each have their successful and erroneous responses defined.

 
Compatibility APIs emulate existing music server APIs like Synology AudioStation and QNAP Music Station, allowing you to use their respective mobile apps with Music Server.  They are not intended for building new clients.
